notes: [P1] construction/fragile: the 40px HUD bar is drawn over the board's top row, not above it, and main.js swallows every click and hover at y < HUD_HEIGHT. Placing a tower on, or hovering, row 0 now only works in the strip below the bar, or not at all if TILE <= 40. Towers or path in row 0 are also hidden under the bar. Nothing tests that row 0 can still be placed on and seen. I could not check design/hud.md from this folder, so I can't tell whether the board was meant to keep its top row under the bar or be pushed down.

[P1] missing test: the main.js wiring is untested. Nothing checks that a click on the bar never reaches placeTower, that hover is cleared over the bar, or that P/F keydown reaches keyHud while the game is running. Only the pure clickHud/keyHud helpers are tested.

[P1] edge: step multiplies dt by speed and has no cap. At 2x a long frame (a tab coming back into focus, if main.js doesn't clamp dt) doubles the jump, so ghosts can skip further along the path and towers fire at most once per step. The 0.5s equivalence test covers ghost position only, not firing or kills.

[P2] test accuracy: in test/hud.test.js, hudButtonAt(speed.x, speed.y + speed.height) is commented 'the board below the bar', but y = 34 is still inside the 40px bar. The assertion is right; the comment is wrong.

[P2] style: P/F keydown events still go to kindForKey, and the HUD keys still toggle after the round has ended. That's harmless because restart rebuilds state with paused false and speed 1, but it's worth a guard for clarity.
